contract.headline: Active undelayed core authority
contract.headline_basis: Derived from the layer rows below, not authored here, so it changes when the walk changes.

layers.target_name: Wrapped stETH and canonical Lido V4 proxy stack

paths.name: no wrapper-local controller
paths.via: wstETH direct deployed code and fixed stETH() dependency
paths.hand_walk: stETH() returned 0xae7ab96520de3a18e5e111b5eaab095312d7fe84. Runtime code is direct and the EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots were zero. Source review found no pause, freeze, confiscation, arbitrary mint, parameter setter, upgrade, or rescue function. The positive control was the live stETH() getter.

paths.name: Lido DAO Agent
paths.via: stETH Aragon app / OssifiableProxy admin -> Agent -> AdminExecutor -> EmergencyProtectedTimelock

reaction_window.basis: 5-day Aragon vote plus 3-day minimum Dual Governance timelock

paths.hand_walk: stETH.kernel() returned 0xb8ffc3cd6e7cf5a098a1c92f48009765b24088dc. Accounting, StakingRouter, AccountingOracle and WithdrawalQueue each returned this Agent from proxy__getAdmin(), with nonzero live implementations. Aragon Voting returned voteTime=432000 seconds, supportRequiredPct=50%, and minAcceptQuorumPct=5%. EmergencyProtectedTimelock.MIN_EXECUTION_DELAY() returned 259200 seconds and getGovernance() returned DualGovernance. Conditional emergency execution is recorded as unresolved below rather than treated as an ordinary bypass.

paths.name: EmergencyProtectedTimelock conditional emergency execution

reaction_window.basis: complete emergency-state predicates and timing bounds were not resolved

paths.reach_bound: ordinary governance is measured at five days of Aragon voting plus the three-day Dual Governance minimum; no emergency bypass, no-delay path, or global floor is inferred
paths.hand_walk: EmergencyProtectedTimelock exposes conditional emergency activation and execution machinery. The completed walk did not resolve every emergency-state predicate, the applicable committee threshold, or the conditional path's enforceable delay. This is an unresolved coverage edge, not evidence that a bypass is active or undelayed.

paths.name: Accounting HashConsensus
paths.via: 5 matching member reports -> AccountingOracle -> Accounting -> stETH

reaction_window.basis: oracle reporting frame is not a holder reaction window

paths.reach_bound: report hash and data must match the current frame and pass AccountingOracle, StakingRouter, withdrawal-queue, and OracleReportSanityChecker validations
paths.hand_walk: getMembers() returned nine addresses and getQuorum() returned five. This path can accept accounting inputs that rebase holder balances and drive withdrawal finalization, but cannot submit arbitrary values: source enforces consensus hash/version/frame checks and downstream sanity checks. The live member list and quorum getters are positive controls for the committee read.

layers.target_name: StakingRouter module allocation and deposit behavior

paths.name: Lido DAO Agent
paths.via: StakingRouter role administration and proxy admin

reaction_window.basis: 5-day vote plus 3-day minimum Dual Governance timelock

paths.hand_walk: StakingRouter proxy__getImplementation() returned 0xdd76927045435c7605cf6f5f978cfb8cabdb5f80 and proxy__getAdmin() returned the DAO Agent. The active module-management role can add, update, pause or remove staking modules and alter target allocations; an implementation replacement has full reach.

paths.name: Lido DAO Agent
paths.via: WithdrawalQueue proxy admin and role administration

reaction_window.basis: 5-day vote plus 3-day minimum Dual Governance timelock

paths.hand_walk: WithdrawalQueue proxy__getImplementation() returned 0xe42c659dc09109566720ea8b2de186c2be7d94d9 and proxy__getAdmin() returned the DAO Agent. Upgrade and role administration can change or gate request, finalization and claim behavior.

paths.name: CircuitBreaker Committee Safe
paths.reach_bound: can pause the queue for the configured 21-day circuit-breaker period; cannot change code or seize holder balances
paths.hand_walk: Live Safe getThreshold() returned three and getOwners() returned six addresses. Official deployed-contract configuration binds this committee through CircuitBreaker 0x6019cb557978296ba3c08a7b73225c0975dfb2f7 to the WithdrawalQueue; the pause is immediate but time-limited.
